description: Validates an Italian PEC (certified email) address: format + domain checked against the list of AGID-certified providers (Aruba, InfoCert, Namirial, Poste, etc.). `is_pec_domain` has THREE values: true (in the AGID list), false (not a PEC), null (the domain contains 'pec' but was NOT verified — not the same as false). The domain is checked, not the mailbox (`non_verificato` in the response). Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

email.description: The PEC address to validate (e.g. mario.rossi@pec.it).

name: validate_pec
title: Validate PEC
